svg.text: Hey, I'm Arthur — a Software Engineering student at PUC Minas. I'm passionate about learning new
technologies, building projects and solving problems through code.
I build backend applications and APIs with Python, Java and SQL, and web interfaces with HTML, CSS
and JavaScript. I like understanding how things work, from the database up to the screen.
Keep growing as a backend developer, ship real projects and turn what I learn in class into
"A man without studies is an incomplete being" — Simón Bolívar.
